pl-l4d15c5-d1e112.summary: States that alms is a work of mercy, and truly it is said: have mercy on your soul, pleasing God.
claims: Alms is a work of mercy that begins with one's own soul.

pl-l4d15c5-d1e118.summary: Warns that those who think they buy impunity by very generous alms while remaining in sins they love deceive themselves; whoever loves iniquity hates his soul and is cruel to it, loving it according to the world, hating it according to God. To give it alms that make it clean, he must hate it according to the world and love it according to God.
claims: Alms cannot buy impunity for sins one loves.
Loving iniquity is cruelty to one's own soul.

pl-l4d15c5-d1e124.summary: Adds that by this alms, which a man owes first to himself, the interior is cleansed.
claims: The alms owed to oneself cleanses the interior.

pl-l4d15c5-d1e127.summary: Cites Christ: 'cleanse what is within'; to the unclean nothing is clean, their mind and conscience are polluted; the unclean are all whom faith in Christ does not cleanse, 'cleansing their hearts by faith'. Yet lest Christ seem to reject alms from earthly goods, he said: these you ought to have done, judgment and the love of God, and not omit those, the alms of earthly fruits.
claims: Faith in Christ cleanses the heart.

pl-l4d15c5.summary: Alms is a work of mercy, and 'have mercy on your soul, pleasing God'. Those who think they buy impunity by generous alms while persisting in sins they love deceive themselves: whoever loves iniquity hates his soul and is cruel to it; to give it alms that make it clean, one must hate it according to the world and love it according to God. This alms one owes oneself first cleanses the interior: 'cleanse what is within', since to the unclean nothing is clean, and faith in Christ purifies hearts. Yet Christ did not reject alms of earthly goods: these ought to be done, the others not omitted.
claims: Alms is a work of mercy that must begin with mercy to one's own soul.
Alms do not buy impunity for persisting in sin.
Faith in Christ cleanses the interior.
Material alms are not rejected but presuppose inner cleansing.
